The `.env.example` file in the `python-backend` codebase provides a template for environment variables related to AWS, NGROK, Auth0, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, and Modal configurations.

# Purpose
This file is a configuration file used to store sensitive credentials and configuration settings for various services and APIs. It includes placeholders for AWS credentials, Ngrok API key, Auth0 authentication details, PostgreSQL database credentials, an OpenAI API key, and Modal token information. These values are typically used by the application to authenticate and interact with these external services securely.
